data.notes: As of October 13, 2026, confirmed May 2027 listings skew toward arena, theater, jazz, Latin, and touring rock/indie concerts; many NYC club and electronic calendars have not yet announced May lineups.

events.title: Leon Bridges: The Happiness Anytime Tour
events.summary: Leon Bridges headlines Madison Square Garden with special guests El Michels Affair and Mari Froes. MSG notes the date is subject to change due to playoffs.

events.title: Cécile McLorin Salvant
events.venueName: Rose Theater, Jazz at Lincoln Center
events.summary: Cécile McLorin Salvant returns to Jazz at Lincoln Center for a three-night Rose Theater run with pianist Sullivan Fortner in her quartet configuration.

events.title: The Love of Soul Tour: Fantasia, Anthony Hamilton, October London
events.summary: Fantasia headlines The Love of Soul Tour at Prudential Center with Anthony Hamilton and October London on the announced lineup.

events.title: The World in Swing: Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra with Wynton Marsalis
events.venueName: Rose Theater, Jazz at Lincoln Center
events.summary: Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra with Wynton Marsalis closes this cross-cultural program with Naseer Shamma, Hamilton de Holanda, and Chano Domínguez on May 1.

events.title: Yuri & Lucero: Entre Amigas Tour
events.summary: Mexican pop icons Yuri and Lucero bring the Entre Amigas Tour to Prudential Center in nearby Newark.

events.title: Ha*Ash: No Me Hablen de Amor
events.summary: Mexican pop duo Ha*Ash brings the No Me Hablen de Amor tour to United Palace in Washington Heights.

events.title: Slash feat. Myles Kennedy & The Conspirators: Flying Blind World Tour
events.summary: Slash brings the Flying Blind World Tour with Myles Kennedy and The Conspirators to Beacon Theatre.

events.title: Flor de Toloache: Cinco De Mayo Celebration
events.venueName: LeFrak Concert Hall, Kupferberg Center for the Arts
events.summary: Latin Grammy-winning all-women mariachi ensemble Flor de Toloache plays a Cinco de Mayo celebration in Queens, blending mariachi with jazz, soul, and pop influences.

events.title: Valery Meladze
events.summary: Valery Meladze performs at Kings Theatre in Brooklyn, with ATG noting the show will be performed in Russian.

events.title: WWSK Presents: The Warning — Everything's Falling World Tour
events.summary: The Warning plays Brooklyn Paramount on the Everything's Falling World Tour, with wilt listed on ticketing and tour pages.

events.title: The Airborne Toxic Event
events.summary: The Airborne Toxic Event plays Irving Plaza on May 21, part of a May 2027 run also routed through Washington, Boston, Cleveland, Detroit, Chicago, and other cities.

events.title: Agnes Obel
events.summary: Danish singer, songwriter, and composer Agnes Obel plays Brooklyn Paramount, with doors and show time listed on the Ticketmaster event page.

events.title: La India / India’s Mother’s Day Concert
events.venueName: Lehman Center for the Performing Arts
events.summary: A Bronx Mother’s Day salsa tradition with La India, the Puerto Rican-born, Bronx-raised “Princess of Salsa,” confirmed for Lehman Center.

events.title: Mass of the Fermenting Dregs
events.summary: LPR presents Japanese post-hardcore and shoegaze trio Mass of the Fermenting Dregs at Knockdown Center on the Iwaou tour.

events.title: Henge
events.summary: UK cosmic rave-prog group Henge plays Brooklyn Bowl, with the venue listing doors at 6 PM and show at 8 PM for an 18+ event.

events.title: Hip Hop Fever
events.venueName: Lehman Center for the Performing Arts
events.summary: A Bronx hip-hop heritage concert confirmed at Lehman Center; season materials describe it as a night bringing together legendary New York City artists, with full lineup still TBA.

events.title: Keo
events.summary: London alt-rock band Keo plays Bowery Ballroom as part of its 2027 tour. The Ticketmaster listing confirms doors at 7 PM and a 16+ show.

events.title: Africa Day Boat Party Edition 1
events.summary: An Africa Day late-night boat party from Pier 36, billed around African music, culture, unity, and national-pride dress codes.
